AdoptCloudBatchRequest.description: Add another computer's cloud job to this computer's jobs, so its subtitles can be downloaded here.
AdoptCloudBatchRequest.title: AdoptCloudBatchRequest

CancelQueuedPodRequest.description: Cancel one of the app's queued pods, terminating a pod it deployed meanwhile; needs `confirm`.
CancelQueuedPodRequest.title: CancelQueuedPodRequest

CancelWorkerRequest.description:
Stop a run: cancel its queued pod (terminating a pod it deployed meanwhile) or terminate its pod.

Without `confirm`, the answer is `needs_confirmation` (the run and its stage), and nothing is changed.
CancelWorkerRequest.title: CancelWorkerRequest

CheckCredentialsRequest.description: Try the credentials against the services (R2: list the bucket; Runpod: read the pod list); changes nothing.
CheckCredentialsRequest.title: CheckCredentialsRequest

CleanupCloudRequest.description:
Delete a batch's audio, or all its data, from the cloud; needs `confirm`.

`everything` on a batch whose results may not be downloaded yet also needs
`confirm_not_downloaded`. A batch this database does not know (another computer's, Q28)
can be cleaned up with `everything` once its manifest reads. When the cloud holds another
computer's batch under the id of one this database knows, deleting it also needs
`confirm_unknown`: the confirmation of the known batch does not cover it.
CleanupCloudRequest.title: CleanupCloudRequest

CloudSetupStatusRequest.description: Report which Runpod objects of the setup are missing, outdated or duplicated; changes nothing.
CloudSetupStatusRequest.title: CloudSetupStatusRequest

CreateBatchRequest.description: Store a new batch in `composing` from a selection.

confirm_existing_languages.description: Create jobs also for languages a file already has a subtitle in.
confirm_existing_languages.title: Confirm Existing Languages

item_languages.description: Other target languages for single files.
item_languages.title: Item Languages

languages.description: Target languages of every selected file.

scan_id.description: Reuse this scan of the same options if this process still keeps it; else scan again.

CreateBatchRequest.title: CreateBatchRequest

CreateRetryBatchRequest.description:
Retry failed or no-speech jobs of a batch in a new batch (mode `careful`, the audio copied in R2).

Repeating the request with the same batch and jobs returns that retry batch and resumes it.
CreateRetryBatchRequest.title: CreateRetryBatchRequest

CredentialsStatusRequest.description: Report which credentials are set and where from; never their values.
CredentialsStatusRequest.title: CredentialsStatusRequest

CustomPlacementOptions.description: Where an imported custom plan's relative output folders start.

include_empty.description: Also place empty subtitles (no speech found).
include_empty.title: Include Empty

output_folder.description: Absolute folder every target of the custom plan must be inside.

overwrite.description: Replace existing target files instead of skipping them.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

CustomPlacementOptions.title: CustomPlacementOptions

DeleteBatchRequest.description: Delete a batch in `composing` or `reviewing` (nothing of it is in the cloud yet); needs `confirm`.

confirm.description: Delete the batch; without it the answer asks first.
confirm.title: Confirm

DeleteBatchRequest.title: DeleteBatchRequest

EditBatchRequest.description: Replace the items of a batch in `composing` with a new selection.

confirm_existing_languages.description: Create jobs also for languages a file already has a subtitle in.
confirm_existing_languages.title: Confirm Existing Languages

item_languages.description: Other target languages for single files.
item_languages.title: Item Languages

languages.description: Target languages of every selected file.

scan_id.description: Reuse this scan of the same options if this process still keeps it; else scan again.

EditBatchRequest.title: EditBatchRequest

ExcludeItemsRequest.description: Remove items from a batch in `reviewing` or `uploading`, deleting their uploaded audio; needs `confirm`.

confirm.description: Remove the items; without it the answer asks first.
confirm.title: Confirm

ExcludeItemsRequest.title: ExcludeItemsRequest

ExportCustomPlanRequest.description: Return the custom plan of the batch's jobs, pre-filled with the mirror folders and the default names.
ExportCustomPlanRequest.title: ExportCustomPlanRequest

ExtractChoice.description: Extract an embedded text subtitle stream as the job's subtitle.
ExtractChoice.title: ExtractChoice

GetAppInfoRequest.description: Ask for the app version and the data contract version (nothing machine-specific).
GetAppInfoRequest.title: GetAppInfoRequest

GetBatchRequest.description: Return one batch with its items and jobs.
GetBatchRequest.title: GetBatchRequest

GetSettingsRequest.description: Ask for the stored settings and every Whisper language (needs no database).
GetSettingsRequest.title: GetSettingsRequest

ImportCustomPlanRequest.description: Validate an edited custom plan file, then place the batch's finished subtitles as it says.
ImportCustomPlanRequest.title: ImportCustomPlanRequest

ItemLanguages.description: Target languages of one selected file, instead of the batch's languages.

path.description: The file's path exactly as the scan reported it.

ItemLanguages.title: ItemLanguages

LaunchWorkerRequest.description:
Start one worker for every pending manifest; needs the fingerprint of the confirmed plan.

Without `confirm_fingerprint`, or when the scope changed since the plan it names, the
answer is `needs_confirmation` with the current plan, and nothing is changed.
LaunchWorkerRequest.title: LaunchWorkerRequest

ListCloudBatchesRequest.description: List every job in the cloud (R2 only): this computer's and other computers' (architecture §3.9).
ListCloudBatchesRequest.title: ListCloudBatchesRequest

ListRunsRequest.description:
List the latest runs as stored, newest first; reads only the database (no Runpod or R2 call).

Elapsed time and cost are as of each run's end, else its last `refresh_status`.
ListRunsRequest.title: ListRunsRequest

NameFilter.description: Match files by their name without the extension, ignoring case.
NameFilter.title: NameFilter

PlacementDefaults.description: Placement choices a download request is pre-filled with (§3.5).
PlacementDefaults.title: PlacementDefaults

PlacementOptions.description: A placement strategy and its parameters.

folder_count.description: flat_with_folders: the number of folders closest to the file joined into the name.
folder_count.title: Folder Count

folder_levels.description: flat_with_folders: explicit folder levels joined into the name instead of the closest ones, counted from the scan root (1 = the first folder below it); not combined with folder_count.
folder_levels.title: Folder Levels

include_empty.description: Also place empty subtitles (no speech found).
include_empty.title: Include Empty

output_folder.description: Absolute target folder of the mirror and flat strategies; ignored by next_to_media.

overwrite.description: Replace existing target files instead of skipping them.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

PlacementOptions.title: PlacementOptions

PlanDownloadRequest.description: Show what a download of the batch's subtitles with a strategy would do; nothing is written.
PlanDownloadRequest.title: PlanDownloadRequest

PlanLaunchRequest.description: Show what a worker started now would process, its runtime limit and its estimated cost; changes nothing.
PlanLaunchRequest.title: PlanLaunchRequest

PreviewSelectionRequest.description: Scan, then apply the selection operations in order; changes nothing.

scan_id.description: Reuse this scan of the same options if this process still keeps it; else scan again.

PreviewSelectionRequest.title: PreviewSelectionRequest

ReconcileCloudRequest.description: List the app's live pods and queued pods, join them with the local runs, resolve `launching` runs.
ReconcileCloudRequest.title: ReconcileCloudRequest

RefreshStatusRequest.description:
Follow the runs that are not final (with a Runpod key) and look for results of `ready` batches.

Past its desktop deadline a run's pod is terminated (verified); a run whose pod is gone is
ended, its `runs/<run_id>/` objects kept locally and deleted.
RefreshStatusRequest.title: RefreshStatusRequest

ResetSettingsRequest.description: Replace the stored settings with the defaults (needs no database; offered when they cannot be read).
ResetSettingsRequest.title: ResetSettingsRequest

ResolveReviewRequest.description: Set the choice of jobs in review; all choices are applied, or none.
ResolveReviewRequest.title: ResolveReviewRequest

RetryJob.description: A transcribe job of a batch, named by its item and language.
RetryJob.title: RetryJob

ReviewBatchRequest.description: Probe the files waiting for review, then return the review views.
ReviewBatchRequest.title: ReviewBatchRequest

ReviewFilter.description: The main view's filters applied to the review views.

folder.description: Only files at or below this folder.

languages.description: Only jobs of these languages (all when empty).
languages.title: Languages

ReviewFilter.title: ReviewFilter

RunDownloadRequest.description: Download the batch's finished subtitles and place them with a strategy (resumable: send it again).
RunDownloadRequest.title: RunDownloadRequest

RunUploadRequest.description: Start or resume a batch's upload: extract, convert, upload and verify, then publish its manifest.
RunUploadRequest.title: RunUploadRequest

ScanSpec.description: What to scan and how to classify it; the GUI fills the defaults from the settings.

include_hidden.description: Also scan hidden and system files and folders.
include_hidden.title: Include Hidden

root.description: Absolute path of the folder to scan.

ScanSpec.title: ScanSpec

ScanTreeRequest.description: List the media files below a folder with their sidecar subtitles; changes nothing.

include_hidden.description: Also scan hidden and system files and folders.
include_hidden.title: Include Hidden

root.description: Absolute path of the folder to scan.

ScanTreeRequest.title: ScanTreeRequest

SelectionFilter.description: The filters active when an operation was made; every given part must match.
SelectionFilter.title: SelectionFilter

SelectionOperation.description: Include or exclude the matching media files at or below a path (a folder or a file).
SelectionOperation.title: SelectionOperation

SetBatchHiddenRequest.description: Hide a finished batch from the default list, or show it again.
SetBatchHiddenRequest.title: SetBatchHiddenRequest

Settings.description: The user's settings (all fields required; see `state.settings.default_settings`).
Settings.title: Settings

SetupCloudRequest.description:
Create or update, by their fixed names, the Runpod objects the worker needs.

The R2 secrets, the Global Volume and the worker template. Duplicate secrets and templates
are deleted (one is kept: the exact-name, oldest secret; a stable pick of the templates that
prefers an up-to-date one); Global Volumes are never deleted, so duplicates stop the request
with `cloud_volume_duplicated`. Idempotent: run it again after an interruption or a
credential rotation.
SetupCloudRequest.title: SetupCloudRequest

StoreCredentialsRequest.description: Store credentials in the keyring; fields left out keep what is stored. Values are never echoed.

r2_access_key_id.description: R2 API token access key id.

r2_secret_access_key.description: R2 API token secret access key.

runpod_api_key.description: Runpod API key of the desktop app.

StoreCredentialsRequest.title: StoreCredentialsRequest

SubtitleFilter.description: Match files by the languages of their (not forced) sidecar subtitles.
SubtitleFilter.title: SubtitleFilter

TerminatePodRequest.description: Terminate one of the app's pods (a straggler or an overdue one); needs `confirm`.
TerminatePodRequest.title: TerminatePodRequest

TranscribeChoice.description: Transcribe the file into the job's language from one audio track.

track_index.description: Audio track of a video file; none for an audio file (uploaded as it is).
track_index.title: Track Index

TranscribeChoice.title: TranscribeChoice

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Replace the stored settings with these (needs no database; the last writer wins).
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest
